標題： 📣3月23日(日) K書中心B館執行消毒作業公告 / Notice of Disinfection at K-Study Center B Building on March 23
日期： Fri, 21 Mar 2025 09:58:57 +0800

各位同學好📣

3月23日(週日)預定中午12:00後於K書中心B館(集賢館2F)進行消毒工作，敬請同學留意以下事項。
一、 在消毒作業進行期間，所有人員都應離開消毒區域。
二、敬請同學將所有物品帶離B館，以免沾染藥劑。
三、K書中心B館將於3月24日(一)上午9:00開放使用
造成不便敬請見諒

教學卓越中心敬啟
------------------------------------------------

Notice of Disinfection at K-Study Center B Building on March 23 (Sunday)

Dear students,
A disinfection procedure will take place at K-Study Center B Building on March 23 (Sunday) at 12:00 PM. Please take note of the following:
1. All personnel must leave the disinfection area during the procedure.
2. Please remove all personal belongings from B Building to avoid chemical contamination.
3.	K-Study Center B Building will reopen on March 24 (Monday) at 9:00 AM.
We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.

Center for Teaching Excellence
